risks: G42 and MBZUAI accounted for a large portion of Cerebras Systems Inc.'s revenue.
AWS has a binding commitment to purchase warrants and may account for a material percentage of our future revenue.
We may not be able to grow our cloud-based offerings into a sustainable part of our business.
We may face rising costs for data center energy demands, which could harm our business.
We are dependent on TSMC for wafer production, which could disrupt our supply chain.

growth_drivers: Cerebras Inference delivers answers up to 15 times faster than leading GPU-based solutions.
Cerebras entered into a Master Relationship Agreement with OpenAI to provide 750MW of AI inference compute capacity.
MBZUAI accounted for 62% of our total revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025.
Revenue from cloud and other services increased by $73.3 million, driven by larger installed bases and growing demand for cloud inference services.
We expect to benefit from the rapid adoption of AI across industries and the emergence of innovative AI use cases and applications.
risks: Cerebras entered into a $250 million revolving credit agreement for standby letters of credit.
We expect overall gross profit to decrease in absolute dollars in the near term due to start-up costs related to expediting cloud capacity.
Future expense amounts could be affected by changes in assumptions or market conditions.

growth_drivers: Cerebras Inference delivers answers substantially faster than GPU-based solutions.
Cerebras entered into a master relationship agreement with OpenAI to supply AI inference compute capacity, starting revenue recognition in Q1 2026.
The On-Demand model allows customers to scale elastically and many have transitioned from on-demand usage to dedicated capacity.
Total revenue for the six months ended June 30, 2026 increased by $170.7 million, or 84%, compared to the same period in 2025.
Cloud and other services revenue increased by $93.0 million, or 281%, for the three months ended June 30, 2026.
risks: Gross margin is expected to be significantly lower in the near term and to fluctuate due to amortization of customer warrant assets and start-up costs.
Total gross margin decreased significantly due to increased research and development expenses.

growth_drivers: Cerebras Systems Inc. secured over 600 megawatts of data center capacity in the last 7 months.
Cerebras' disaggregated inference solutions with AMD increase throughput by 5x while maintaining speed.
Cerebras will unveil the CS4 at their annual Supernova Conference next week, doubling their speed each year for the next several years.
We won one of the largest technology deals ever, creating RPO of more than $25 billion.
Cerebras is on track for significant growth, with revenue expected to increase more than 3x in 2027.
risks: First revenue starting in mid-2027 and ramp through 2028 and beyond.

growth_drivers: OpenAI is a big part of the business.
Cerebras Systems will deliver its service through Amazon's API service, Bedrock, in Q1.
Partnerships that increase throughput while maintaining speed, enhancing revenue and margins.
Disaggregated inference solutions are planned for commercialization in Q4.
The company has signed 600-megawatt capacity and expects a 10x increase in capacity by the end of the year.
